issue.title: [Web UI] A single Ctrl+V image paste creates two attachment chips (clipboard.png + image.png)

relevant_locations.role: Webview container managing extension bridge and UI communication
Bridge handler coordinating messages between webview and backend runtime

llm_context.input_title: [Web UI] A single Ctrl+V image paste creates two attachment chips (clipboard.png + image.png)
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: In the Kimi-code Web UI, pressing Ctrl+V once to paste a screenshot results in two attachment chips (`clipboard.png` and `image.png`) being created, indicating that multiple handlers (such as a paste event and a clipboard poll) are triggering on the same clipboard item.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: Two distinct event or polling handlers in the web interface independently detect and process the clipboard contents upon a single paste action, resulting in dual file creation without proper deduplication or event prevention.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect clipboard paste event handling
step_by_step_plan.description: Inspect KimiWebviewProvider in apps/vscode/src/KimiWebviewProvider.ts and BridgeHandler in apps/vscode/src/bridge-handler.ts to locate where paste events and clipboard items are processed.

step_by_step_plan.title: Deduplicate clipboard processing
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the paste event listener or bridge message handler in apps/vscode/src/bridge-handler.ts to check if an identical clipboard image has already been handled or queued within a short time window.

step_by_step_plan.title: Prevent default or stop propagation
step_by_step_plan.description: Ensure event propagation is correctly handled and default actions are appropriately prevented in KimiWebviewProvider when processing clipboard paste events to avoid double-firing.

step_by_step_plan.title: Execute test suite for verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Run the test suite using the verified test command to verify that single paste actions result in exactly one attachment chip without breaking existing behavior.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Managing browser DOM events so that user actions do not trigger multiple redundant handlers.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Failing to stop propagation or handle duplicate triggers leads to redundant state mutations and duplicate UI elements.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Fixing the duplicate paste issue requires ensuring that paste events and clipboard polling mechanisms do not both process the exact same clipboard item simultaneously.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Accessing and reading image or text payloads from the system clipboard securely via browser APIs.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Properly handling clipboard data streams prevents unexpected binary files or incorrect filenames from populating user inputs.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Helps distinguish between `clipboard.png` and `image.png` sources to unify or filter redundant capture paths.

common_pitfalls: Modifying backend handlers when the duplicate event trigger resides entirely in frontend UI event listeners.
Forgetting to check for duplicate filenames or concurrent asynchronous clipboard reads.
